description:
Configure the Copper Point of Sale regional settings to match United Kingdom standards.

Goal: Adapt the system for a UK retail store.

Instructions:
1. Open the Options/Preferences menu in Copper POS.
2. In the Regional (or General) settings, change the Currency Symbol to '£'.
3. Change the Date Format to 'dd/MM/yyyy' (Day/Month/Year).
4. In the Tax settings, rename the default 'Sales Tax' to 'VAT'.
5. Save your changes.

Note: Ensure all three settings (Currency, Date, Tax Name) are updated correctly.
